body: Hot dogs: 100% beef, natural casing, 8-pack/16oz, $12, STINKIES NACHO KIT bundle $26, frozen cold chain. Cigarettes: full flavor king size, matte black hard box, $14/pack + $120/carton, private-label FDA-registered manufacturer, physical retail distribution only (DTC blocked by PACT Act/carrier rules), HEIMDAL approval required for all tobacco procurement.
title: S142-01 + S143-01: STINKIES hot dogs + cigarettes briefs
